subject: ophthalmology
title: Corneal ulcers and keratitis

steps.tx: **Bacterial corneal ulcers** follow epithelial breakdown (trauma, contact lens overwear, dry eye, lid disease) with pain, photophobia, ciliary injection, grey infiltrate and anterior chamber cells; **hypopyon** layers pus inferiorly behind severe ulcers (sterile reactive in most bacterial disease, infected in fungal). Scraping for Gram, KOH and culture precedes fortified antibiotics (cefazolin plus aminoglycoside patterns, fluoroquinolone monotherapy for small peripheral lesions); steroids wait until infection controlled. Contact lens related Pseudomonas melts rapidly with greenish discharge and needs admission.
steps.say: Grey spot plus pain plus red eye after lens overwear: scrape then fortify. Pus level in front chamber marks severe ulcer.

steps.tx: **Fungal ulcers** (vegetative trauma, filamentous Fusarium and Aspergillus) grow dry raised lesions with feathery edges, satellite infiltrates and stubborn hypopyon, needing KOH scraping and natamycin or voriconazole for weeks; steroids worsen them. **Acanthamoeba keratitis** haunts soft lens wearers rinsing lenses in tap water, with excruciating pain out of proportion, radial perineuritis and ring infiltrate, treated with biguanides (PHMB, chlorhexidine) plus diamidines for months. Both masquerade as bacterial disease failing antibiotics, so atypical ulcers need confocal and repeat scraping.
steps.say: Plant injury ulcer that ignores antibiotics is fungal until scraped. Agonising lens related ulcer with ring is acanthamoeba.

steps.tx: **Herpes simplex keratitis** declares dendritic branching ulcers staining with fluorescein (terminal bulbs), typically after febrile illness or steroids, treated with topical aciclovir or oral valaciclovir; stromal disciform disease and neurotrophic melting follow recurrences, needing antivirals plus cautious steroids only with cover. **Herpes zoster ophthalmicus** (Hutchinson nasal tip sign) threatens Hutchinson plus uveitis and postherpetic neuralgia, needing systemic antivirals within 72 hours. Adenoviral keratoconjunctivitis leaves nummular subepithelial infiltrates with glare for months.
steps.say: Branching ulcer with bulbs is herpes simplex: aciclovir, never steroid alone. Nasal tip blisters warn the eye is next.

steps.tx: Descemetocele (transparent bulge to Descemet), perforation with flat chamber and Seidel positive leak, and endophthalmitis are ulcer emergencies needing tissue adhesive, patch graft or therapeutic **keratoplasty**. Optical penetrating keratoplasty replaces full thickness scarred cornea with donor tissue under steroid and rejection vigilance (Khodadoust rejection line, Khodadoust management with intensive steroids); lamellar techniques (DALK, DSEK, DMEK patterns) spare layers for keratoconus or endothelial failure. Corneal blindness needs eye banking with specular screening and short death to preservation time.
steps.say: Leaking ulcer with flat chamber grafts urgently. Rejection line on graft endothelium needs steroid rescue.
